capabilities: Open or create the Daily Note for a clicked date
Create multi-day period tasks by dragging on the calendar
Adjust task duration by dragging the task edges
Check off period tasks across all Daily Notes in the range
Configure the heading section where tasks are inserted
extras: The author states the project is in its early stages and invites feedback via GitHub Discussions; feature requests and bugs go through GitHub Issues or PRs.
intentEvidence: manage them in blocks (fully integrated with Daily Notes)
motivation: The author wanted a conventional-calendar-like way to visually track period schedules inside Obsidian without giving up their Daily Notes workflow.
problem: Obsidian's Daily Notes cannot represent schedules spanning multiple days, forcing users to duplicate tasks across notes and check each one off manually.
summary: Calendar view that manages multi-day tasks across Daily Notes: drag-and-drop to create period tasks synced to every Daily Note in the range.
